First community release of LaTeX Live: native `.tex` editing in Obsidian, local TeX compilation and PDF preview, bidirectional SyncTeX, source/live modes, texlab assistance, project-aware formula rendering, expandable proof-reference graphs, and self-contained HTML export.

Requires desktop Obsidian 1.13.7 or later and a separately installed TeX distribution. texlab and YOLO are optional, separately installed integrations. HTML export currently supports pdfLaTeX and XeLaTeX; LuaLaTeX remains supported for PDF compilation.

The project's own code is MIT-0. Upstream software and referenced materials retain their own licenses. See the README and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for installation, file access and optional-network disclosures.
